title: Sordland/Turn08/Personal_PetrTalk
description: Petr has a heart to heart with the President visiting campaign office. Petr admits an affair. Tell Lucian, Call Evelyn, Don't Do Anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a dark, chilly evening when..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a dark, chilly evening when Petr called and asked if we could meet. He gave no details -- all he said was that it was important.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I drove alone through Holsord's sub..."
entries.dialogueText: I drove alone through Holsord's suburbs until I reached the meeting point he named: 147 Wruhec Avenue, number 26. Our old campaign headquarters, untouched since the night of the election. This was where everything began.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I made my way up the dusty staircas..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way up the dusty staircase of the office building. The light in the second-floor hallway was out, so I used a cigarette lighter to find my way to the wooden door marked 26. I pulled on the handle, but it wouldn't budge. The heavy door had always been a pain to open.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Coming.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Coming.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr pushed on the door with all hi..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr pushed on the door with all his weight. It made a screeching sound as it opened.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Without further ado, I bid you wel..."
entries.dialogueText: “Without further ado, I bid you welcome to this grand nostalgia trip, hosted by yours truly, Petr Vectern!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Feeling sentimental yet?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Feeling sentimental yet?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not really. It's just an office.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not really. It's just an office.”
entries.menuText: “Not really. It's just an office.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Indeed. I haven't been to this pla..."
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed. I haven't been to this place in ages!”
entries.menuText: “Indeed. I haven't been to this place in ages!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He made an exaggerated bow. The dus..."
entries.dialogueText: He made an exaggerated bow. The dust from the opened door was still settling down.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I remember it as being much cleane..."
entries.dialogueText: “I remember it as being much cleaner.”
entries.menuText: “I remember it as being much cleaner.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That's what time does to things, m..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's what time does to things, my friend. You're looking a little shabbier yourself than you did back then."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Well, I for one am overflowing wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, I for one am overflowing with nostalgia.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I miss it sometimes. Even that dam..."
entries.dialogueText: “I miss it sometimes. Even that damn door.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Come over here. Remember this?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Come over here. Remember this?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He walked over to his old desk and..."
entries.dialogueText: He walked over to his old desk and pointed to the gramophone that had annoyed our neighbors and kept us company for so many late nights. Petr filpped the switch, and it filled the room with swing music from the '20s.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I'll be damned. It still works.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll be damned. It still works.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So, what are we celebrating?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So, what are we celebrating?”
entries.menuText: “So, what are we celebrating?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you going to tell me why we ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you going to tell me why we are here?”
entries.menuText: “Are you going to tell me why we are here?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I thought this office was sold off..."
entries.dialogueText: “I thought this office was sold off.”
entries.menuText: “I thought this office was sold off.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Life, my friend. Life.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Life, my friend. Life.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“No, I've been paying the rent. Too..."
entries.dialogueText: “No, I've been paying the rent. Too many memories attached to this place just to sell it. And you know, we might use it again soon..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“In a bit.”"
entries.dialogueText: “In a bit.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He put his hand under the desk and..."
entries.dialogueText: He put his hand under the desk and brought a bottle out. He took a swig out of it and passed the bottle to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took a swig as well before passin..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a swig as well before passing the bottle back to Petr.
entries.menuText: Drink.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Aren't there any glasses?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Aren't there any glasses?”
entries.menuText: “Aren't there any glasses?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Palace life is pampering you too m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Palace life is pampering you too much. Just drink from the bottle like the old days. Remember where we come from.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That's my boy.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That's my boy.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr snapped his fingers to the mus..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr snapped his fingers to the music while going through the items in the room. It looked virtually unchanged since election night.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Come on, have a look around. See i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Come on, have a look around. See if it doesn't bring back memories."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I made my way to the gramophone and..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way to the gramophone and started flipping through the records next to it.
entries.menuText: Go through the records next to the gramophone.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I walked over to the tower of stora..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over to the tower of storage boxes and opened one of them.
entries.menuText: Look through the storage boxes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I walked over to my old desk, sat d..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over to my old desk, sat down on the squeaky chair and opened the top drawer.
entries.menuText: Check your old desk drawers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside, there were a few old coins,..."
entries.dialogueText: Inside, there were a few old coins, pencils and sheets of paper. Underneath them, something caught my eye.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a photograph of me and Monic..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a photograph of me and Monica, sitting under a tree. This must've been 10, maybe 15 years ago. We looked so young and so happy. Monica would love to see this.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Nice find. Look at baby Anton! You..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nice find. Look at baby Anton! You didn't even have your iconic look.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took the photograph and slid it i..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the photograph and slid it into my jacket pocket.
entries.menuText: Take the photograph.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I put the photograph back into the..."
entries.dialogueText: I put the photograph back into the desk drawer.
entries.menuText: Put the photograph back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In one of the storage boxes, I foun..."
entries.dialogueText: In one of the storage boxes, I found a heavy object, wrapped safely. I unwrapped it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was an emerald-colored statue of..."
entries.dialogueText: It was an emerald-colored statue of a goat, the symbol of Sordland. I remembered that this was a gift from Brenda: one of the '53 election campaign assistants. It would look good on my desk in the palace.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Brenda, Brenda, Brenda. Always suc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Brenda, Brenda, Brenda. Always sucking up to you, and where did it get her? Seriously, where? I have no idea where she ended up."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left the statue where it was."
entries.dialogueText: I left the statue where it was.
entries.menuText: Leave the statue.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I lifted the storage box with the s..."
entries.dialogueText: I lifted the storage box with the statue in it and put it near the door so I could take it on the way out.
entries.menuText: Take the statue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I found one of my favourite albums..."
entries.dialogueText: I found one of my favourite albums ever: Mountains by Janit Gurz. A set of plaintive folk songs that made me yearn for the countryside whenever I heard it.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“What a classic! You should mail th..."
entries.dialogueText: “What a classic! You should mail that to Franc so he can learn what real music is.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left the record where it was."
entries.dialogueText: I left the record where it was.
entries.menuText: Leave the record.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pulled the record out, put it und..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled the record out, put it under my arm and placed it next to the door.
entries.menuText: Take the record.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You said you wanted to talk about..."
entries.dialogueText: “You said you wanted to talk about something on the phone.”
entries.menuText: “You said you wanted to talk about something on the phone.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You called me here just for nostal..."
entries.dialogueText: “You called me here just for nostalgia?”
entries.menuText: “You called me here just for nostalgia?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't tell me Petr Vectern is gett..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't tell me Petr Vectern is getting sappy in his old age.”
entries.menuText: “Don't tell me Petr Vectern is getting sappy in his old age.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yes. Erm, no. We'll talk about it...."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. Erm, no. We'll talk about it. All in good time."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Not that old! But yes, it happens..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not that old! But yes, it happens to the best of us.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the bottle he had in..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the bottle he had in his hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took a swig out of it before pass..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a swig out of it before passing it back to Petr.
entries.menuText: Drink.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, I'm good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, I'm good.”
entries.menuText: “No, I'm good.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shrugged, took a very big gulp o..."
entries.dialogueText: He shrugged, took a very big gulp out of the bottle and staggered to the side afterwards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a very big gulp out of the..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a very big gulp out of the bottle and staggered to the side afterwards.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you all right?""
entries.dialogueText: “Are you all right?"
entries.menuText: “Are you all right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.
entries.menuText: Don't say anything.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I know you, Petr. What are you hid..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know you, Petr. What are you hiding?”
entries.menuText: “I know you, Petr. What are you hiding?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yeah. Yeah, I'm okay. Let's go up..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yeah. Yeah, I'm okay. Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Let's go up to the roof. The view..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Nothing. Let's go up to the roof...."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing. Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We went up the stairs to the roof...."
entries.dialogueText: We went up the stairs to the roof. The view was mesmerizing. The buildings of Holsord twinkled below us, while the stars shone bright in the sky.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We sat and leaned back against a wa..."
entries.dialogueText: We sat and leaned back against a wall, taking it all in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right as I was starting to get up,..."
entries.dialogueText: Right as I was starting to get up, I heard a sobbing sound. I turned to Petr and saw tears streaming down his cheeks.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pretended not to notice his tears..."
entries.dialogueText: I pretended not to notice his tears.
entries.menuText: Pretend not to notice.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's wrong?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What's wrong?”
entries.menuText: “What's wrong?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I've not yet seen a night sky beau..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've not yet seen a night sky beautiful enough to make Petr Vectern cry.”
entries.menuText: “I've not yet seen a night sky beautiful enough to make Petr Vectern cry.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He wiped the tears away and laughed..."
entries.dialogueText: He wiped the tears away and laughed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He wiped the tears away."
entries.dialogueText: He wiped the tears away.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I messed up Anton. I messed up big..."
entries.dialogueText: “I messed up Anton. I messed up big time.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Evelyn's leaving me. She wants a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evelyn's leaving me. She wants a divorce."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not surprised."
entries.menuText: “I'm not surprised."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You two have always had rough patc..."
entries.dialogueText: “You two have always had rough patches. I'm sure you'll kiss and make up."
entries.menuText: “You two have always had rough patches. I'm sure you'll kiss and make up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What the hell did you do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell did you do?"
entries.menuText: "What the hell did you do?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It's different this time.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's different this time."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I've been sleeping with Livia Suno..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've been sleeping with Livia Suno.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You've been WHAT?!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You've been WHAT?!”
entries.menuText: “You've been WHAT?!”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I know, she's your secretary. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know, she's your secretary. I'm so sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I had a feeling about you two.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I had a feeling about you two.”
entries.menuText: “I had a feeling about you two.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We got careless, I know. I'm so so..."
entries.dialogueText: “We got careless, I know. I'm so sorry.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Shit. What if this causes a scanda..."
entries.dialogueText: “Shit. What if this causes a scandal?”
entries.menuText: “Shit. What if this causes a scandal?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“It won't. I'll keep it all under w..."
entries.dialogueText: “It won't. I'll keep it all under wraps. I'm so sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How could you do this to me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How could you do this to me?”
entries.menuText: “How could you do this to me?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will be blunt. You will fix this..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will be blunt. You will fix this or I will remove you from office."
entries.menuText: “I will be blunt. You will fix this or I will remove you from office."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yes Anton. I understand. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes Anton. I understand. Thank you so much."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“All right. It's just an affair, an..."
entries.dialogueText: “All right. It's just an affair, and it's over at that. We can weather this."
entries.menuText: “All right. It's just an affair, and it's over at that. We can weather this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You've done enough damage. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: “You've done enough damage. I will handle it myself.”
entries.menuText: “You've done enough damage. I will handle it myself.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Thank you, Anton. That means a lot..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Anton. That means a lot to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for his reaction, I..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for his reaction, I left the rooftop alone and made my way downstairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On my way out, I grabbed my belongi..."
entries.dialogueText: On my way out, I grabbed my belongings and took one last look back at the office. It had been home to some happy memories for sure, but this visit had permanently cured me of any nostalgia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On my way out, I took one last look..."
entries.dialogueText: On my way out, I took one last look back at the office. It had been home to some happy memories for sure, but this visit had permanently cured me of any nostalgia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I arrived home, I headed..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I arrived home, I headed up to my study, sat down and stared at the telephone.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the phone and dialed Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone and dialed Lucian's number.
entries.menuText: Call Lucian and tell him what happened.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I headed to the bedroom without cal..."
entries.dialogueText: I headed to the bedroom without calling anyone. Petr and I would be able to handle this between ourselves.
entries.menuText: Trust Petr and call no one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stared at the receiver, wondering..."
entries.dialogueText: I stared at the receiver, wondering what his last statement meant. What was going on that I didn't know about?

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Yes, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I told Lucian everything Petr had t..."
entries.dialogueText: I told Lucian everything Petr had told me about himself, Evelyn and Livia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a photograph of me and Monic..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a photograph of me and Monica, sitting under a tree. This must've been 10, maybe 15 years ago. Her expression in it sent pangs through my heart. I couldn't even imagine her looking at me that way now.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Enough going through old stuff. Le..."
entries.dialogueText: “Enough going through old stuff. Let's talk.”
entries.menuText: “Enough going through old stuff. Let's talk.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thanks, but I'd rather not.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks, but I'd rather not.”
entries.menuText: “Thanks, but I'd rather not.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Suit yourself.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Suit yourself.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Petr shrugged.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yes, yes. All in good time.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, yes. All in good time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up very quickly."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up very quickly.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for calling me, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for calling me, Mr. President. This serves to confirm some suspicions of my own. We have to meet.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The line dropped."
entries.dialogueText: The line dropped.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No, I guess you shouldn't be.”"
entries.dialogueText: "No, I guess you shouldn't be.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“It's just, Evelyn hasn't been the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's just, Evelyn hasn't been the same since she lost her job, and Livia was giving me sultry looks from the day I hired her..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“You were away, I was drunk, one th..."
entries.dialogueText: “You were away, I was drunk, one thing led to another."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But she's more than just a pretty..."
entries.dialogueText: "But she's more than just a pretty girl, Anton! She's smart and kind... I think we really connected."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I like her, too. That doesn't mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like her, too. That doesn't mean I'd break my vows and risk a scandal for a bit of horizontal polo!"
entries.menuText: "I like her, too. That doesn't mean I'd break my vows and risk a scandal for a bit of horizontal polo!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't tell me you're going to run..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't tell me you're going to run off with her!"
entries.menuText: "Don't tell me you're going to run off with her!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No, no. We're ending things. I tol..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, no. We're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I know, I know. But we're ending t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, I know. But we're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the phone and dialed Pe..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone and dialed Petr's home number.
entries.menuText: Call Evelyn.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, maybe I can speak to Evelyn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, maybe I can speak to Evelyn and plead your case."
entries.menuText: "Well, maybe I can speak to Evelyn and plead your case."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's too late. There's still a cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late. There's still a chance this could get out. I need to talk to Lucian."
entries.menuText: "It's too late. There's still a chance this could get out. I need to talk to Lucian."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still can't believe this. I ough..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still can't believe this. I ought to have you both fired."
entries.menuText: "I still can't believe this. I ought to have you both fired."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who else knows besides me and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who else knows besides me and the three of you?"
entries.menuText: "Who else knows besides me and the three of you?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nobody, I swear!""
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody, I swear!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton, please! I'm begging you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, please! I'm begging you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was an edge of desperation in..."
entries.dialogueText: There was an edge of desperation in Petr's voice. He took another drink.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""How many years have we known each..."
entries.dialogueText: "How many years have we known each other? How many scrapes have we gotten ourselves out of? I can handle this myself. Just trust me and don't bring anyone else into this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton. You'd do that for me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton. You'd do that for me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd do it for my best friend. What..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd do it for my best friend. What evidence does she have of the affair?"
entries.menuText: "Of course I would. What evidence does she have of the affair?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd do it for my presidency. How d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd do it for my presidency. How did Evelyn find out?"
entries.menuText: "No, I'd do it for my administration. How did Evelyn find out?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""She wrote me a rather saucy note...."
entries.dialogueText: "She wrote me a rather saucy note. I made the mistake of putting it in my pants pocket on laundry day."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just words. We'll find a way to sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just words. We'll find a way to spin it."
entries.menuText: "Just words. We'll find a way to spin it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's the kind of stupidity that..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the kind of stupidity that ends presidencies."
entries.menuText: "That's the kind of stupidity that ends presidencies."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've known Evelyn almost as long a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've known Evelyn almost as long as you. I'll talk some sense into her."
entries.menuText: "I've known Evelyn almost as long as you. I'll talk some sense into her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr's eyes welled up."
entries.dialogueText: Petr's eyes welled up.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't deserve you. Either of you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't deserve you. Either of you. Thank you for this, Anton."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. Mistakes happen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. Mistakes happen."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. Mistakes happen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Anything for my best friend.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything for my best friend."
entries.menuText: "Anything for my best friend."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't mention it. I mean it -- *do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."
entries.menuText: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I haven't done anything yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't done anything yet."
entries.menuText: "I haven't done anything yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to face my friend and Vice..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to face my friend and Vice President. The habits that had gotten him dubbed the "bad boy of Sordish politics" when we were young were no longer so charming coming from a middle-aged man. Yet he was still a capable politician, and I couldn't ignore our long history together.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. Mistakes happen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. Mistakes happen."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. Mistakes happen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Anything for my best friend.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything for my best friend."
entries.menuText: "Anything for my best friend."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't mention it. I mean it -- *do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."
entries.menuText: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tomorrow?""
entries.dialogueText: "Tomorrow?"
entries.menuText: "Tomorrow?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Right now?""
entries.dialogueText: "Right now?"
entries.menuText: "Right now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What suspicions?""
entries.dialogueText: "What suspicions?"
entries.menuText: "What suspicions?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Tomorrow morning in your office. E..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tomorrow morning in your office. Early, before either of the two arrive."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'd rather discuss this in person...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather discuss this in person. Tomorrow morning in your office. Early, before either of the two arrive."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, but early, before either of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but early, before either of the two arrive."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Don't bring this up with anyone el..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't bring this up with anyone else. I fear we may have more than a mere dalliance on our hands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went to bed, but couldn't sleep a..."
entries.dialogueText: I went to bed, but couldn't sleep at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I slipped into bed, careful not to..."
entries.dialogueText: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. Petr and Evelyn hadn't made it -- were we next? I hadn't cheated on her, but what I had done was arguably worse...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't sleep at all that night."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't sleep at all that night.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I slipped into bed, careful not to..."
entries.dialogueText: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. Petr and Evelyn hadn't made it -- were we next?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I slipped into bed, careful not to..."
entries.dialogueText: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. I would tell her the news about Petr and Evelyn tomorrow. I hoped it wouldn't upset her too much.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn answered after a few rings."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn answered after a few rings.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Anton, it's late. Is everything al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, it's late. Is everything all right?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I told her what I knew about her, P..."
entries.dialogueText: I told her what I knew about her, Petr and Livia.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was silent for so long I though..."
entries.dialogueText: She was silent for so long I thought she might have hung up.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Whatever you have to say, it won't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you have to say, it won't change my mind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr still loves you. He was in te..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr still loves you. He was in tears when we talked."
entries.menuText: "Petr still loves you. He was in tears when we talked."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you understand? Your jealous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you understand? Your jealousy could ruin my chances of re-election."
entries.menuText: "Don't you understand? Your jealousy could ruin my chances of re-election."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's already ended it. Can't you f..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's already ended it. Can't you forgive him?"
entries.menuText: "He's already ended it. Can't you forgive him?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Evelyn, please. I didn't call to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evelyn, please. I didn't call to change your mind. I'm on your side."
entries.menuText: "Evelyn, please. I didn't call to change your mind. I'm on your side."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""You think this is about jealousy?""
entries.dialogueText: "You think this is about jealousy?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Do you know Petr at all? Really kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know Petr at all? Really know him?"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Livia wasn't the first, and she wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Livia wasn't the first, and she won't be the last. There'll always be another beautiful young woman for him to prey on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Preyed on? Livia was a willing par..."
entries.dialogueText: "Preyed on? Livia was a willing participant."
entries.menuText: "Preyed on? Livia was a willing participant."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's not fair. Petr says they ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not fair. Petr says they had a real connection.."
entries.menuText: "That's not fair. Petr says they had a real connection.."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He has a wandering eye. You knew t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has a wandering eye. You knew that when you married him."
entries.menuText: "He has a wandering eye. You knew that when you married him."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""Was she? Look at whom he goes afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was she? Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""What do they have in common? When..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do they have in common? When the vice president asks them for sex, they might lose their job if they refuse."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""I thought I could help curb his wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought I could help curb his worst impulses, but it obviously wasn't true. Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""He said that, did he? Look at whom..."
entries.dialogueText: "He said that, did he? Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""I'd go to the media about this if..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd go to the media about this if I wasn't persona non grata at the Holsord Post. And if there was a shred of a chance I'd be taken seriously."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""But at the very least, I will no l..."
entries.dialogueText: "But at the very least, I will no longer be an accomplice to his abuse of power. And frankly, Anton, neither should you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn hung up without waiting for..."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn hung up without waiting for me to respond. I took a minute to think over what she had said.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Still holding the receiver, I diall..."
entries.dialogueText: Still holding the receiver, I dialled Lucian's number.
entries.menuText: Call Lucian and tell him what happened.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I put down the phone and headed to..."
entries.dialogueText: I put down the phone and headed to the bedroom. Nobody else had to get involved in this.
entries.menuText: Put the phone down.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No need to justify. Men will be me..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to justify. Men will be men, after all."
entries.menuText: "No need to justify. Men will be men, after all."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm glad you understand. In any ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you understand. In any case, we're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ha! That's all? You lucky man!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ha! That's all? You lucky man!”
entries.menuText: “Ha! That's all? You lucky man!”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Thanks. I wish my wife saw it that..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks. I wish my wife saw it that way.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, thank you.”
entries.menuText: “No, thank you.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Come on Anton. I insist.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Come on Anton. I insist.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd rather not.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd rather not.”
entries.menuText: “I'd rather not.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Fine...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Fine...”

Petr Vectern
Player
entries.title: Player: ""I... I'm sorry. I don't know what..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... I'm sorry. I don't know what to say."
entries.menuText: "I... I'm sorry. I don't know what to say."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""*Now* you're on my side?""
entries.dialogueText: "*Now* you're on my side?"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""You're his best friend, Anton. Don..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're his best friend, Anton. Don't tell me you had no idea what he was getting up to all this time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. He behaved despicabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. He behaved despicably, and I did nothing to stop him."
entries.menuText: "You're right. He behaved despicably, and I did nothing to stop him."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""To be fair, neither did I. For yea..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be fair, neither did I. For years."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: ""But look at the women he goes afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "But look at the women he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I guess I didn't want to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess I didn't want to know."
entries.menuText: "I guess I didn't want to know."
